title: Scaffold App.tsx, main.tsx, router
description: Create entry point with React Router 7, QueryClientProvider, theme provider. All 11 routes defined (lazy-loaded). cn() utility in lib/utils.ts. Files: main.tsx, App.tsx, lib/utils.ts, lib/constants.ts.
definitionOfDone: main.tsx renders App into #root with StrictMode
All 11 routes defined with lazy(() => import()) for each page
cn() utility using clsx + tailwind-merge in lib/utils.ts

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/lib/utils.ts with cn() utility using clsx + tailwind-merge. This is imported by all existing UI components (Button, etc.) so must match existing import path '../../lib/utils'.
implementationPlan.note: Installed tailwind-merge and created cn() utility

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/lib/constants.ts with API_BASE_URL from import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL (default '/api/v1'), WS_BASE_URL for WebSocket, and APP_TITLE. No secrets in client bundle — only VITE_* env vars.
Create dashboard/src/lib/format.ts with formatCount() utility (imported by AppShell). Minimal implementation: format numbers with K/M suffixes for nav badge counts.

Create stub Zustand stores that AppShell imports: state/ui.ts (useUiStore: theme, globalSearch, commandOpen, toggleTheme, setGlobalSearch, setCommandOpen), state/events.ts (useEventStore: status as 'connected'|'connecting'|'disconnected'), state/config.ts (useConfigStore: apiBaseUrl, apiKey, principalId, principalRole, update()). Use 'state/' directory to match existing AppShell imports. Token stored in Zustand + localStorage, cleared on logout.

Create stub hooks/useAuthConfig.ts exporting useAuthConfig() React Query hook (imported by AppShell). Returns auth config shape: { password_enabled, saml_enabled, default_tenant }. Fetches GET /api/v1/auth/config (public endpoint, no auth required).

Create stub lib/api.ts with api object matching AppShell's usage: api.getSession(), api.logout(), api.listApprovals(limit), api.listDLQPage(limit). Uses fetch with auth headers (Authorization + X-Tenant-ID). Throws typed errors. This is a bridge until the full api/client.ts is built in the next task.

Create dashboard/src/App.tsx with: QueryClientProvider (React Query), BrowserRouter, Routes definition with all routes lazy-loaded via React.lazy(). Routes: / (HomePage), /login (LoginPage), /jobs (JobsPage), /jobs/:id (JobDetailPage), /workflows (WorkflowsPage), /workflows/:id/runs/:runId (RunDetailPage), /agents (AgentsPage), /policies (PolicyPage), /approvals (ApprovalsPage), /audit (AuditPage), /dlq (DLQPage), /packs (PacksPage), /settings (SettingsPage), /schemas (SchemasPage), /runs (RunsPage), /pools (PoolsPage), /system (SystemPage), /context (ContextPage), /trace (TracePage), /tools (ToolsPage), /search (SearchPage). Protected routes wrap AppShell + Suspense fallback. /login is unprotected. Include React.Suspense with loading fallback for lazy routes.
Create dashboard/src/main.tsx: imports React, ReactDOM, App, and styles/index.css. Renders <StrictMode><App /></StrictMode> into document.getElementById('root').

Create placeholder page components as minimal stubs (just a div with page name) so lazy imports don't fail: pages/HomePage.tsx, pages/LoginPage.tsx, pages/JobsPage.tsx, pages/JobDetailPage.tsx, pages/WorkflowsPage.tsx, pages/RunDetailPage.tsx, pages/AgentsPage.tsx, pages/PolicyPage.tsx, pages/ApprovalsPage.tsx, pages/AuditLogPage.tsx, pages/DLQPage.tsx, pages/PacksPage.tsx, pages/SettingsPage.tsx, pages/SchemasPage.tsx, pages/RunsPage.tsx, pages/PoolsPage.tsx, pages/SystemPage.tsx, pages/ContextPage.tsx, pages/TracePage.tsx, pages/ToolsPage.tsx, pages/SearchPage.tsx. Each exports default function component.
Verify: run tsc --noEmit from dashboard/ to confirm no type errors. Fix any import mismatches between AppShell's expectations and the new stubs.
implementationPlan.note: Created vite-env.d.ts for import.meta.env types and lib/status.ts for StatusBadge dependency. tsc --noEmit passes clean.
